SELECT
  adm.hospital_expire_flag AS in_hospital_death_flag,
  COUNT(*) AS n_admissions,
  ROUND(AVG(los_days), 2) AS mean_los_days,
  ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(los_days, 0.5), 2) AS median_los_days,
  ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(los_days, 0.75), 2) AS p75_los_days,
  ROUND(PERCENTILE_CONT(los_days, 0.90), 2) AS p90_los_days,
  ROUND(
    SUM(CASE WHEN los_days <= 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*)
    , 4
  ) AS pct_rank_5_day
FROM (
  SELECT
    p.subject_id,
    adm.hadm_id,
    adm.hospital_expire_flag,
    -- Compute LOS in days
    TIMESTAMP_DIFF(adm.dischtime, adm.admittime, SECOND) / 86400.0 AS los_days
  FROM
    `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.patients` p
    JOIN `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.admissions` adm
      ON p.subject_id = adm.subject_id
  WHERE
    p.gender = 'M'
    AND p.anchor_age BETWEEN 57 AND 67
    AND adm.admission_type != 'ELECTIVE'
    -- Exclude any zero or negative LOS if present
    AND TIMESTAMP_DIFF(adm.dischtime, adm.admittime, SECOND) > 0
) sub
GROUP BY
  in_hospital_death_flag
ORDER BY
  in_hospital_death_flag;
